card.name: Linking words in pollution and emissions text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (through, in, and, to, of, by) inside sentences about environmental pollution, such as mercury, e-waste burning and carbon emissions in news articles.

modes.label: Linking words before burning or use
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction that sits just before a cause of emissions, such as burning or use of an element.
modes.example: thousands of unemployed people make a living by recycling electronic waste<< through>> burning.

modes.label: Links in mercury release sentences
modes.description: Words like in, and, to, mainly to in sentences about sources of mercury releases.
modes.example: owing mainly to the use of the element<< in>> small-scale gold mining and to the burning

card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in news text about pollution and emissions, right before the cause is named.
